input_binding.raw_network: Recorded Overpass walk query -> OSMnx 2.1.1 public graph_from_polygon -> unsimplified MultiDiGraph, all components retained -> GraphML
input_binding.raw_features: Recorded OSM school/library query -> OSMnx features GeoDataFrame -> filtered input geometries -> projected representative points
input_binding.native: OSMnx 2.1.1 and NetworkX 3.7 public APIs, municipal recipe in urban_mcp_walking.engine
input_binding.mcp: Separately implemented MIT FastMCP 3.4.2 adapter, 15 tools; no unlicensed third-party MCP source redistributed
input_binding.scope: 2 km core plus 2 km extra graph buffer; denominator mapped core amenity=school objects; destinations amenity=library excluding access=no/private; max snap 150 m
input_binding.distance: Minimum graph length plus both unverified straight snap connectors; threshold 1200 m; minutes assume 4.8 km/h
input_binding.scenario: Remove both directions and all parallel edges for the explicitly selected node-pair link; hypothetical, not observed works

scope: Only this central study disk, pinned OSM observations, 1200 m school-object/library experiment, documented route/statistics/export operations and hypothetical closure. No complete municipal territory, public admission, population, wheelchair, calibrated time or full OSMnx admission.

municipal_case.question: Which mapped school objects in the central study disk have a modeled library route within 1200 m, and what changes under one declared link closure?

agent_acceptance.codex: All 15 tools and exact artifacts verified; observed brief passed primary-agent factual review
agent_acceptance.hermes: All 15 tools and exact artifacts verified; free prose failed factual review and is NOT admitted for unsupervised municipal recommendations

admission_meaning: Reproducible computational workflow for this declared study area and parameters, not authoritative service adequacy or autonomous planning advice
